_note: Cell values for exporting a kgbench prototype run in kgc-trace/1.1 so that the file also passes Thesis A's shared-minimum-log/1 checker. kgbench runs are not cells of the experiment: there is no F2 sample manifest, no PG/RDF arm and no S1-S4 treatment. Every value below is therefore a PLACEHOLDER for a format demonstration and is marked as such in run_start.cell_source. For a real cell, the launcher supplies this file from the sample manifest.
_sample_manifest_sha256_note: not a real manifest hash: a 64-hex placeholder, because Thesis A's schema does not allow null here
_harness_commit_note: used only when the run manifest records no git commit; 40 zeros as in Thesis A's example file

unit.chunk_rule: whole file (kgbench: one unit per source file)
